science.classification: uncalibrated educational synthetic model, not clinical measurement
rules: DNA amount changes during valid extension, never just because a temperature label changes.
Ideal exponential oracle N(c)=N0*(1+E)^c applies only before saturation, with all requirements met.
Normal lesson efficiency and plateau are model parameters, not predictions for the real assay.
No polymerase or no dNTP prevents new complete target amplicon. Dye absence preserves possible amplification but removes amplification-dependent reporter signal.
A missing acquisition yields null, not zero. Raw SYBR and ROX signals are saved before normalization.
Baseline/threshold are analysis state; changing them cannot mutate DNA or acquired raw signals.
Cq is first valid threshold intersection; no crossing is null. Invalid threshold location is flagged.
Clean synthetic NTC has no target; contaminated or primer-dimer scenarios may fluoresce. SYBR reports total dsDNA, not sequence identity.
Melt decrease derives from dsDNA fraction vs temperature. One peak does not prove target identity.
UDG acts on uracil-containing carryover DNA; it does not destroy all contamination or native dT DNA.
Counterfactual removal of premix components is labelled a teaching experiment.
ROX absence makes reference normalization unavailable, not PCR inhibition; preserve raw signal.

referenceOracle.conditions: ideal E=1, gain=1, no baseline/noise/saturation, threshold=2^20

limits: No claim of validated kinetics, limit of detection or thermal uniformity
No physical layout of unseen optics asserted
science.pauseApproximation: Teaching proposal: thermal/dsDNA melt fraction follow model temperature; scheduled amplification and normal acquisition are suspended with saved resume cursor. Real reagent kinetics during instrument pause are not calibrated; paused runs are separate from uninterrupted ideal oracle.

requirements.description: One locked QS5 A28139 identity and one plate/sample identity across every display
Closed exterior matches nominal 270x500x400 mm; unknown local dimensions labelled estimates
Official front/top/rear diagrams and oblique photo compared with same model views
No top user hinge or unsupported carrier relocation
Amplification, optical acquisition, curve and Cq come from same well state
Initial quantity, NTC, missing synthesis ingredient and missing detection ingredient have distinct causal outcomes
Holds start after modeled target reached; common simulation clock, independent of frame rate
Transactional save/restore preserves complete checkpoint without silently discarding old save
Real 3D picks and normal UI complete supported operations
Measure normal and heaviest view at standard speed; 30fps target remains explicit
Blend reopen, GLB unique IDs/axes/units, TS build and offline local loading
Reload, switch view, repeated state restore and resource disposal verified
PC and touch-sized UI; WebKit basic flow separately from real Safari/mobile
Synthetic/uncalibrated/mode distinctions visibly persist in screenshots and outputs
